name: tree-public-cao-bennett-dual-pae-veto
hypothesis: When both AF2 and RF2 interface PAE exceed 20 angstrom, tie their jointly unresolved interface regime at zero; otherwise retain the two-model mean. This coarse threshold separates highly uncertain relative placement from a usable interface and is fixed once from the signal scale. A joint veto may reduce noisy tail order without the top-ranking dilution of global structural recapitulation.
